question: What is the scope of the reality to be meditated upon in every place?
premises: Meditation is to be done in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that reality which extends from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated in every place on that which extends from Śiva down to Avīci...
